purpose: A bilingual, date-pinned, non-evaluation text-frequency corpus for E13 lexical-row stratification only.

source_selection.rationale: Wikinews supplies real article text in both required scripts, is not a held-out Hawking capability corpus, is available from a dated first-party dump, and is small enough for a bounded CPU-only transform.

excluded.FLORES_plus: withheld because it is gated evaluation data and requests exclusion from model training; E13 representation selection would create avoidable evaluation-contamination ambiguity
excluded.existing_hawking_corpora: measured insufficient for the four Han cells
excluded.Wikipedia_full_dumps: unnecessary multi-gigabyte acquisition for this bounded discriminator

source_selection.license_note: Most Wikimedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL; this derived corpus is internal evidence and is not committed or redistributed. Source project, dump URL, date, and transformation remain recorded for attribution.

transform.selection: namespace 0, non-redirect pages with non-empty current revision text
transform.emission: UTF-8 title, LF, exact XML-decoded revision text, LF, in source dump order
transform.normalization: XML entity resolution and XML line-ending normalization performed by Python stdlib ElementTree only; no markup stripping, sampling, deduplication, Unicode normalization, or language cleanup

e13_design_frozen_before_occupancy.failure_policy: If any of the eight cells has fewer than 512 eligible rows, seal the refusal. Do not tune thresholds against observed occupancy.

claim_boundary: This freezes corpus sources, transform, strata, splits, and seeds before corpus-derived cell counts are inspected. It does not establish that the corpus fills the design, authorize row extraction, execute E13, establish a representation, construct a complete NR, measure EBPW/TPS/capability, promote Pulsar, deploy Hawking, or retire Kimi.
